title: A BUN–creatinine response surface fails its registered renal-marker transfer test, with regularization-dependent results
abstract: A registered BUN–creatinine tensor-spline model (ridge alpha1) failed to improve transferred log-UACR prediction: weighted MSE 0.795411 to 0.813722, delta +0.018311 (joint PSU bootstrap95% [0.000933,0.314267]). Stronger source-selected regularization gave a small exploratory point improvement, so this is a negative result for the registered model, not evidence against all joint physiology. Exploratory transfer from NHANES2009–2010 to independently recruited2015–2016; not untouched confirmation or external-health-system validation.
